evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 濂溪乐处
evidence.excerpt_zh: 濓溪樂處之南為彚萬總春之廟正殿為蕃育羣芳五楹殿東北樓為香逺益清樓西為樂天和為味真書屋又西為池水共心月同明廟東沿山徑出為普濟橋（圓明園册）臣等謹按彚萬總春之廟以祀花神殿樓諸額皆皇上御書池水共心月同明額世宗御書
evidence.summary: South of 濓溪樂處: the flower-spirit temple 彚萬總春之廟, with the five-bay 蕃育羣芳, 香逺益清, 樂天和, 味真書屋, 池水共心月同明 and the 普濟橋.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 汇万总春之庙
evidence.summary: The flower-god temple garden on the south shore of 濂溪乐处, from early Qianlong: five-bay 蕃育群芳, tower with plaques 涵虚朗鉴 and 香远益清, 乐天和, 味真书屋, an open hall 池水共心月同明, and the boat-shaped 宝莲航.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
